digest.component_or_area: CLI command parsing and argparse factory system
propositions: Advanced command grammars (bridge, reconcile, audit, workflow, identity, gate, LLM/review) currently use inline argparse construction and manual dispatch instead of reusable factory contracts
Parser factories must be lean modules that import no optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing)
Parse-failure handling differs between current SystemExit(2) and S2a RebarArgumentParser.error() raising ParseError, requiring uniform translation to exit code 2 with identical stderr/usage output
Commands with bespoke parser presentation (usage, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) must preserve exact behaviors through optional keyword passthroughs in the S2a factory
Every registered advanced route must resolve to a valid S2a parser factory reference and construct successfully in a no-extras environment, proving generation readiness without executing handlers
